comparison.objective: Follow a person's lead to co-carry a pipe onto two stands; candidate removes and recovers tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Human-coordinated load sharing and long-object placement versus fine coaxial tooling, hammer-force regulation, and small-fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Pipe supported on both stands and released versus four safe fractures and complete tang containment.
comparison.reason: Different tested ability and outcome; generic bimanual coordination is insufficient to establish overlap.
